levels.name: Street level: station building under the tracks (common waiting room for bus and train), Stasjonstorget / Folangerveien
levels.note: Wikipedia: the station is elevated; the station building is built under the tracks and is a common waiting room for bus and train passengers; indoor waiting room and kiosk. OSM: underpass w187993310 (layer -1, ~40 m) through the building area and a second underpass w415488429 (~36 m) about 69 m to the west. Station building architect Arne Henriksen, rebuilt 2017 (Bane NOR). Signposted level names not found.

answers.question: (no open-question list for Norway; levels, ways to the platforms, entrances and shops requested)
answers.answer: Elevated station: the station building/waiting room sits under the tracks with entrances from Stasjonstorget (south) and Folangerveien (north, bus terminal side). Two island platforms (spor 1/2, 3/4) reached by stairs, wheelchair ramps up to both island platforms and lifts to all platforms (Bane NOR). OSM maps the underpasses but no lifts or ramps. Shops: Narvesen, Joker Sandvika stasjon, Backstube.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-s-/sandvika/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Sandvika Station" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sandvika_Station, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-SV.json), read 2026-10-30
